name: remove_party_character

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_RemovePartyCharacter passes the top character ID to func_0013C7D0 and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_0013C7D0 searches the four party-roster bytes at game-state offsets 0x48E through 0x491, shifts later members left when it finds the requested ID, and fills the final slot with -1. The two JP calls remove character IDs 1 and 2 consecutively in pc01.ard.
